sideB.summary: DELIVERED: 851 AND ABOVE. The work brought the world back. Cities are growing and people have hope. Leaders lost faith, and they did not. The century will be remembered as dark, with light ahead. The Hollow Men are free, and the Faded are finally free of exile on the havens. DELIVERED: 701-850. They persevered. Some cities were saved and civilization rekindled. Faded, non-Faded, and Hollow Men hope to find a way to coexist. The world moves on, hopefully for the better, though some cities may never recover.
sideB.text:
DELIVERED: 851 AND ABOVE
The work brought the world back from disaster. Cities are growing and people have hope. Leaders lost faith, but they never did. The century will be remembered as a time of darkness with light ahead. The Hollow Men have been freed, and the Faded are finally free from exile on the havens.

DELIVERED: 701-850
They persevered. Some cities were saved and civilization has been rekindled. Faded, non-Faded, and Hollow Men hope to coexist. The world will move on, hopefully for the better, although some cities may never recover.
